optional_capabilities.notifications: Native macOS notifications only. No content capture, mirroring, or banner suppression.
optional_capabilities.wifi: Nearby scans may require Location Services; saved credentials remain managed by macOS.
optional_capabilities.bluetooth: macOS asks for Bluetooth access when the user first invokes device controls.
optional_capabilities.location: Location-aware features stay off unless selected and are governed by macOS privacy controls.
optional_capabilities.screen_capture: One-shot capture tools request access only when the user invokes them.
optional_capabilities.audio: The generic local audio helper is separate and needs System Audio Recording consent when started.
optional_capabilities.accessibility: Accessibility and Input Monitoring are only relevant for selected window or input actions.
optional_capabilities.yabai: Compatible current yabai releases support Mac++ workspace moves with SIP enabled; the optional scripting addition requires a manual RecoveryOS security decision.
